remarks: *Best & Final Monday 8/11 at NOON*,Discover the perfect blend of space, comfort, and convenience in this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome nestled within the sought-after Glen Arthur Estates community. Featuring a fully finished basement and a versatile layout, this home is ready to accommodate your lifestyle.  Step inside to an inviting open-concept living and dining area with warm hardwood floors and a cozy gas fireplace-perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining friends and family. The bright eat-in kitchen opens to a private bluestone patio, ideal for morning coffee or intimate outdoor gatherings.  Upstairs, the spacious primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings, a generous walk-in closet, and a full en-suite bath. Two additional well-sized bedrooms and a second full bath complete the upper level, providing plenty of room for family, guests, or a home office.  The finished basement adds valuable living space that can serve as a media room, gym, playroom, or family room. It also includes an additional storage room with built-in cabinetry and a laundry area equipped with two washers and one dryer for added convenience.  Additional benefits include an attached one-car garage, driveway parking, and ample guest parking. Enjoy exceptional commuter access-just a 5-minute walk to Glenbrook train station, 4 minutes to I-95, 10 minutes to the Merritt Parkway, and 10 minutes to downtown Stamford's vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment. This home is AS IS!
